<tspan x="834.0" dy="0">Read bottom to top; all module internals follow the same direction.</tspan>
<tspan x="834.0" dy="16.52">Same operator color does not imply shared weights; instance/parameter identities are preserved in IR.</tspan>
<tspan x="834.0" dy="16.52">Solid edges carry values; dashed edges carry topology, shape or loop state. Library kernels stay opaque.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="834.0" y="2070" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="834.0" dy="0">Reviewed static source + selected profile. Repeated groups are templates; shapes are not runtime observations.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="834.0" y="2100" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="834.0" dy="0">E### = source span; dashed = side / shape dependencies; fork/join roles are typed in IR; no implicit sum.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="834.0" y="2125" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="834.0" dy="0">Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.</tspan>
</text>

sourceProfile.selected_configuration: explicit static module profile; not a runtime observation

sourceFacts: Each sketch owns independently generated h/s buffers registered at construction; they are shared across calls and have no optimizer parameters.
CountSketch uses signed hash scatter_add, then legacy torch.rfft spectra are multiplied using the actual real/imag formula, followed by legacy irfft.
This is feature-axis circular convolution of sketches; source does not explicitly sum spatial positions, normalize, or add signed square-root postprocessing.
Historical FFT APIs are preserved as source boundaries; no upstream code was run or silently migrated.
Graph ranks only allocate space. Explicit edges supply real operands; no upstream code is imported or executed.
sourceSemantics: recorded graph projection; imported SVG glyphs; source model not executed
